title: L-leucine muscle-function comparison: 2020 nursing-home trial and LACE

source_review_ledger_check.interpretation: Source2020 explicitly names L-leucine. LACE read main/protocol/registry names leucine, with no catalog/CAS/stereo string; do not invent purity/product equivalence. Main-catalog/NIH exact lexical join is not current availability, approval or preparation efficacy.

earlier_working_tree_check.scope: Uncommitted225-entry working tree at time of check, not the ledger of commit f2fe957.

studies.read_depth: Complete scientific main and native Figures1/2; native structured Tables1/2; complete current registry protocol.

identity.route: oral, dissolved in water or juice
identity.schedule: Morning shortly after breakfast (9–10 am) and afternoon (4–5 pm) for 13 weeks
identity.comparator: Lactose 6 g/day on the same schedule
identity.baseline_and_endpoint_window: Baseline approximately five weeks before randomization; re-evaluation within one month after intervention completion.

design.setting: Three nursing homes in Valencia, Spain
design.confirmed_sarcopenia_required: Not an explicit inclusion requirement in Methods; inclusion required ability to walk six metres and age 65 or over.
design.analysis: Completers only, not intention-to-treat; explicitly acknowledged
design.masking: Double-blind as reported; supplier product-developer coauthors performed blinded allocation and reportedly did not see participants/results
design.sequence_concealment_algorithm: Not described in sufficient detail to reproduce
design.statistics: Mann–Whitney between-arm tests; nominal .05 threshold; no multiplicity correction described; multiple sarcopenia and respiratory endpoints.

outcomes.interpretation: Relative preservation vs placebo slowing; not proven large improvement above own baseline

outcomes.unit: baseline=100 percent; raw pressure unit not assigned here
outcomes.interpretation: Preserved expiratory-pressure performance; not direct diaphragm-force/clinical respiratory-event endpoint

outcomes.limit: Baseline index8.3vs10.4kg/m2 differed(P=.02);loss of post-treatment baseline imbalance significance is not proof of a treatment effect.

safety.reported: Authors describe tolerability; no adverse events recorded among dropouts; weekly gastrointestinal enquiry was specified.
safety.blood: Selected post-treatment hematology/chemistry markers showed no significant differences; creatinine0.82 versus0.81mg/dL,P=.91.
safety.limit: Not comprehensive proof of no harms, clinical renal equivalence or long-term/pediatric safety.

source_issues: Completion prose gives 42, 86%, and 14 men plus 29 women. Native flowchart 19+23 supports 42, or 84% of 50.
Baseline handgrip Results3.3 values 43.03/35.97 conflict with Table1 values 16.3/19.2 kg; no silent repair.
Power paragraph says crossover although the actual study and registry describe a parallel trial.
Reported large Cohen d values were not independently validated; individual normalized observations are unavailable.
Abstract/discussion lean-mass benefit is not supported by the actual baseline-relative comparison, P=.168.
Current registry enrollment59 versus paper50; registry minimum age60 versus paper65.
Current registry primary outcomes are mass, strength and walking; respiratory strength is secondary, unlike the paper broad primary grouping.
Registry masking text names microcrystalline cellulose and prebiotics while arm text names lactose; registry noon/8pm timing differs from main9–10am/4–5pm.
Registry current version was updated6April2020 after27March publication; original prespecification is not established from the current snapshot.
studies.statistics_note: Reported individual endpoint tests are retained; no participant-level recalculation or multiplicity-adjusted efficacy claim.

studies.read_depth: Complete scientific main/native Figures1/2 and structured Tables1–6;complete extractable supplement text plus native TablesS3/S4;selected protocol sections;complete current WHO-format registry.

identity.supplier: Amino GmbH, Freilstedt, Germany as printed
identity.release_packaging: Tayside Pharmaceuticals, Dundee; quality testing and qualified-person release; 400-g pots
identity.stereochemistry_limit: Read main, protocol and registry use leucine without an explicit L-isomer string or CAS. This does not demonstrate a different isomer, but batch or retail-product equivalence is not verified.
identity.route: oral with meals;powder mixed with food/drinks/yoghurt
identity.factorial_other_intervention: Independent randomization to perindopril erbumine 2mg then4mg or capsule placebo; not an inseparable leucine–perindopril preparation.

design.stopped_reason: Slow recruitment; funder stopped the trial
design.sarcopenia_definition: Low BIA mass plus low gait/grip at entry; DXA reclassification limits; only44 met confirmed EWGSOP2019 criteria.
design.allocation: Remote concealed web system; site stratification and minimization with a random element
design.masking: Participants/research team/outcome assessors masked;analysis unmasking after completion
design.primary: SPPB difference over repeated six- and twelve-month follow-up
design.analysis: Modified intention-to-treat mixed models with baseline/minimization covariates and available follow-up; not145 complete observations.
design.multiplicity: Explicitly no adjustment for multiple testing

primary_outcome.interpretation: Overall null with imprecision; confidence interval permits meaningful benefit and worsening, not equivalence.

secondary_outcomes.unit_limit: Main abstract labels kg; supplementS3 defines appendicular mass divided by height squared. Units are not silently converted or repaired.

secondary_outcomes.interpretation: Nominal worse score among multiple unadjusted tests; not a general harm conclusion.

subgroups.label: Protein intake below median1.01g/kg/day
subgroups.prespecification: Main describes prespecified; current protocol mentions protein interaction, but final SAP was not read.

subgroups.label: Age over80
subgroups.prespecification: Main describes prespecified; published protocol statistics describes age above/below median.

studies.subgroup_interpretation: Positive within-subgroup estimates are retained. Reported nonsignificant interactions do not establish responder selection or overturn the overall null; no participant-level reanalysis of the subgroup or interaction estimates was performed.

safety.interpretation: Overall event counts were similar, as authors describe. This is not absence of events, causal renal protection or long-term safety. Independently randomized perindopril exposure is preserved.

source_issues: Abstract72/72 is inconsistent with145 total and Table1; leucine comparison is72/73.

Published protocol includes3- and9-month SPPB visits; final main uses6/12. Current registry labels12-month SPPB primary, whereas journal emphasizes repeated follow-up. Both reported primary and12-month sensitivity results are null.
Current registry target352 differs from protocol recruitment440 including dropout allowance; retain both scopes.
Published protocol perindopril capsule filler is lactose whereas final main names cellulose; leucine powder placebo is lactose in both.
Table5 faller counts total67 across perindopril categories versus64 across leucine categories; unresolved. Do not reconstruct individual fall risk from these inconsistent counts.
Final statistical analysis plan and registry history were not read; no perfect-prespecification claim.

gene_and_function_boundary.interpretation: Actual human functional tests merit comparison; mechanistic background or lean mass does not establish BUBR1 restoration or MVA efficacy.

competitiveness.disposition: Retain mixed human functional comparator: selected2020 walking/expiratory-pressure preservation contrasted with larger LACE primary and functional nulls.
competitiveness.fairness: Neither current nominee has demonstrated MVA benefit; leucine is not rejected solely for that shared limitation.
competitiveness.niacin: Leucine functional signals are actual intervention results; niacin retains separate NAD engagement and restoration hypothesis. No head-to-head or MVA superiority is established.
competitiveness.apitegromab: Does not replace the existing stronger randomized disease-specific motor-function comparison on these mixed older-adult sources; SMA-to-MVA transfer is also unproved.
competitiveness.promotion: No automatic nominee replacement or patient recommendation.

notice_check.method: Fresh EuropePMC exact-ID core records and exact-DOI correction/retraction searches; no linked notice identified.
